verdict.rationale: Base44 docs clearly show built-in scaffolding for sign-up/login flows, including email and social providers (Google, etc.), with customizable/translatable pages for login, register, forgot/reset password (base44-docs-11, base44-docs-30, base44-docs-25). However, a disclosed security vulnerability shows the underlying registration/email-verification endpoints could be exploited using only a non-secret app_id to sign up as an editor/collaborator on any app, undermining confidence that the scaffolded auth system works securely as documented (base44-comm-5). Missing for 10: independent confirmation the vulnerability was fully patched, broader coverage of additional social providers beyond Google, and hands-on verification of the sign-up flow post-fix.
